Pawan Kalyan's wife adopts zoo animals

Anna Konidela, wife of actor and politician Pawan Kalyan, has adopted an elephant and a tiger at the Visakhapatnam Zoo. The adoptions were made to support the zoo's animal upkeep and conservation efforts. This initiative aims to provide financial assistance for the care of the adopted animals.
